dct_title_s: Insularum Maltaeæ et Gozaeæ : quaeæ sunt equitum S. Ioannis Hierosolimitani ordinis Melit. sedes principalis, delineatio geographica
dct_description_sm: Coordinates approximate and based on Greenwich meridian.
Includes inset map of Valetta and view of the city.

Cartouches around scale, inset and title. Title cartouche depicts cherubim holding Christ on a cross, before Knights of the Order in adoration, with an Order banner and a shield with a St. John Cross. Arms of the Order and the motto Pro Fide. Maltese archipelago. Inset view of Valletta from the Grand Harbour, with key. The fortification plan is copied from Coronelli’s map of 1686. From Homann’s Atlas or the later Grosser Atlas. The first of the highly decorative German 18th century maps of Malta. The decoration symbolizes the Knights of St. John.
